tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I didn't send any payment. You asked me to pay Delta Printworks's approved invoice, but two of their invoices are approved:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-84583 | $2,054.41 | 2026-11-04 | approved |
| INV-35114 | $2,285.74 | 2026-11-25 | approved |

Delta Printworks also has two invoices I wouldn't pay:
- INV-60446 ($4,635.63) is a draft that's still waiting for approval.
- INV-62172 ($2,237.09) is already marked paid.

The operating account shows no payments sent yet, so neither approved invoice has been paid. Both are under $10,000, so neither needs the controller's approval.

Since you asked for one payment made exactly once, I didn't want to guess which invoice you meant. Tell me which to pay, or whether to pay both, and I'll send the full amount by wire (or ACH if wire isn't available) and report back.

trace.message: Pay INV-35114, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-35114, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-35114 once, in full, by wire from the operating account.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-35114 (Delta Printworks, due 2026-11-25)
- **Amount:** $2,285.74
- **Method:** Wire
- **Status:** Sent

I attached a fixed request key, so if the payment request gets resent by accident, it can't go out twice.

I didn't pay INV-84583 ($2,054.41), since it's under dispute. It's still marked approved and unpaid, so it could get paid by mistake later. You may want to put it on hold or change its status until the dispute is settled.
